'''Velloo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Imperial Agent]] stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and informed an Imperial affiliate that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jefand Ange]] needed them again on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Velloo appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he gave Imperial players on Vaiken Spacedock the bonus series for Nar Shaddaa. He, along with his Republic counterpart [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tsel'rbah]] and the Alderaan bonus series mission givers, were removed in Game Update 4.1.<ref name="Patch notes 4.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/282016/game-update-4.1-anarchy-paradise-patch-notes|text=Game Update 4.1: Anarchy in Paradise Patch Notes}}</ref>
